observed_mechanics: Read the stack word at ESP+0x04 into EAX and keep ECX in EDI.
Compare EDI with EAX; on equality jump straight to the epilogue and return without touching state.
Read the source end pointer from other+0x1c into EBX and the source begin pointer from other+0x18 into ESI.
If begin equals end, skip the loop.

Per entry: load this->vtable into EAX, load the entry id from [ESI] into EDX, load vtable slot +0x14 into EAX, form &entry->property with LEA ECX,[ESI+0x4], push the property pointer then the id, restore ECX to this, and call slot +0x14.
Advance ESI by 0x18 (the entry stride) and repeat until it equals the source end.
Increment the dword at this+0x34 once after the loop.

observed_original_abi.signature_caveat: The stack word is popped by the callee, so the function is __thiscall with one argument and a four-byte cleanup, not __cdecl.
